---
name: draft-tech-spec
description: Establish an evidence-backed technical specification by inspecting the repository first and asking focused questions only for material, unresolved decisions. Use for non-fast-path discovery, plan stress tests, or when the user mentions "draft tech spec".
---

Start with repository and task evidence. Record what is known, what is inferred, and what requires a user decision. Do not ask about facts that can be established by exploration.

For a material unresolved decision, ask one question at a time and provide a recommended answer. Stop interviewing once the remaining requirements are evidenced or explicitly decided; do not create an open-ended interview loop.

If a question can be answered by exploring the codebase, explore the codebase instead.
